_README: Shipped seed knowledge: recognizers NetAuditAI ships with, so a fresh deployment already reads
common security settings in unfamiliar vendor syntax before an administrator teaches anything.
Each entry is loaded through the same gates as an administrator-confirmed recognizer
(app.facts.recognizers.validate_recognizer) and stored in SQLite with source='seed'.
These dialects have NO dedicated parser and stay unconfirmed/generic: 'vendor' is a label only.
Adding one: see docs/seed-knowledge.md. Never put a secret, a hostname or an address in a template.
